comparison.objective: Set paper-tray side guides; candidate commissions an adjustable damper.

comparison.success_condition: Correct guide spacing/alignment is implied; candidate requires consecutive safe impacts and witness-tested lock stability. Paper-size tolerance and scoring details are absent.
comparison.reason: Both adjust a setting, but the record tests static spacing while the candidate tests force-dependent stopping behavior and mechanical lock retention.
